createXid.description: Transaction id that created this node.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this node was created.

modifyXid.description: Transaction id of the last modification to this node.

modifiedAt.description: Timestamp of the last modification to this node.

version.description: Number of changes to the data of this node.

ephemeralOwner.description: If this node is ephemeral, this is the session id of the creator.

numChildren.description: Number of children for this node.

childrenXid.description: Transaction id of the last modification to a child of this node.

childrenVersion.description: Number of changes to the children of this node.

aclVersion.description: Number of changes to the ACL of this node.

title:
Type that maps a zookeeper the node Stat object. It will always be generated as a member of
the ZookeeperNode.
name: ZookeeperStat
